newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Analysts' comments on Roche H1 result.
newsitem.headline: Analysts' comments on Roche H1 result.

text.p: Following are analysts' comments on first half results reported by Roche Holding AG, which showed a 10 percent rise in group net profit.
Birgit Kulhoff, Union Bank of Switzerland (UBS ):
"The result is disappointing and below my expectation.
"Higher marketing costs had been expected, but the price pressure mentioned by Roche and higher costs for research and development were surprising.
"If this price pressure turns out to be permanent, I will reduce my forecasts.
"Roche has previously said expenditure for research and development should be lowered as a percentage of sales."
Daily Market Opinion by Zurich Kantonalbank:
"The operating margin worsened by three percentage points, mainly due to higher price pressure and worsened product mix. That is unfortunately negative.
"The rise in group net profit is above our expectations due to the gratifying financial income.
"But we attach higher weight to the weaker operating result, which leads to short-term pressure."
